name: Omapop
author: Jon Kinney
description: Select text with the mouse and a small bar of actions appears beside it: cut, copy, paste, search, open links, reveal paths, and extensions written as YAML snippets, shell scripts or JavaScript. Supports a reviewed subset of the PopClip Extensions Directory (https://www.popclip.app/extensions/).

service.description: Watches for mouse text selections through a small Hyprland Lua engine, reads the Wayland primary selection, and shows the action bar. The compositor is the only place that sees mouse-button releases and the cursor, so the trigger has to live there.

barWidget.description: Manage extensions and settings; right click to pause or resume the selection bar.

schema.label: Search engine
schema.description: Used by the built-in Search action. Choose 'other' to use the custom URL below.

schema.label: Custom search URL
schema.description: Used when the engine is 'other'. Put *** where the selected text goes, e.g. https://example.com/search?q=***

schema.label: Drag threshold (px)
schema.description: How far the pointer must move between press and release for the gesture to count as a drag selection.

schema.label: Bar position
schema.description: Auto puts the bar above the pointer, or below it when the drag went downwards, so it never covers the selection.

schema.label: Assume unknown fields are editable
schema.description: When neither the accessibility bus nor the window class says whether the selection is in an editable field, treat it as editable anyway. Off by default, so page text in a browser never offers Cut, Paste or text-replacing actions. Browsers report their fields once they are restarted with accessibility on (see the README).

schema.label: Detect editable fields via accessibility
schema.description: Keeps a small AT-SPI helper running and turns on the session accessibility flag. It checks editable fields and text-selection ranges at the gesture's starting point, so selecting the same text can work without a fresh primary-selection event. Browser and Electron apps may need a restart.

schema.label: Hide when pointer moves away (px)
schema.description: The bar disappears once the pointer is this far from it.

schema.label: Show on long press
schema.description: Off by default. Hold the left button for half a second without moving to offer Paste, even without a selection or field detection. No Shift is needed in terminals.

schema.label: Require Shift in terminals
schema.description: Hold Shift while selecting in terminal windows to show Omapop. Prevents stale popups when Herdr, tmux or another terminal app copies and clears its own selection. Applies at plain shell prompts too; long press and the keyboard shortcut still work.

schema.label: Largest selection read (KiB)
schema.description: Selections larger than this are ignored.

schema.label: Excluded apps
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes where the bar never appears (see hyprctl clients).

schema.label: Terminal window classes
schema.description: Windows whose paste shortcut is Ctrl+Shift+V and which cannot cut.

schema.label: Extensions' 'command' key maps to
schema.description: Global default for macOS Command shortcuts. Each installed extension can override this from its gear menu.

schema.label: Allow extension installs
schema.description: Allow installing reviewed directory extensions, including bundled Linux ports. Every installation asks for confirmation; new extensions start disabled.

schema.label: Keep the extension catalogue up to date
schema.description: Once a week, fetch the published listing for 'Available extensions'. This contacts popclip.app and cannot change Omapop's approved packages or versions. Update also works by hand.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut
schema.description: Optional Hyprland bind that shows the bar for the current selection, e.g. SUPER + SHIFT + P. Leave empty for none.

schema.label: Show icon in the bar
schema.description: Hide the bar icon if you only want the popup. Settings stay reachable through omarchy-shell.
